description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Pro Integrate is seeking a Software Engineer, Internal Platforms to build and improve internal tools, services, and workflows that support operations, products, and AI-driven infrastructure. The role focuses on end-to-end fullstack development, platform reliability, data modeling, collaboration across teams, and resolving production issues.
Full-stack engineer building internal platform systems, backend APIs, frontend tools, and reliable data services

Responsibilities:
• Contribute to the design and development of end-to-end fullstack systems powering critical internal workflows and platform capabilities
• Build clean, scalable backend services and APIs with clear contracts and ownership
• Develop high-quality, performant frontend interfaces used by internal teams and stakeholders
• Participate in data modeling and database performance optimization (schema design, query tuning, maintainability)
• Collaborate closely with product, operations, and design teams to translate ambiguous requirements into scalable systems
• Improve platform reliability, observability, and developer experience across internal tooling
• Uphold engineering quality through code reviews, testing, and continuous improvement
• Help debug and resolve production issues while improving operational resilience
• Make pragmatic tradeoffs between speed, scalability, and maintainability in a fast-moving environment

Requirements:
• Experience building or contributing to production fullstack systems (internships, projects, or professional experience)
• Strong TypeScript fundamentals across frontend and/or backend
• Familiarity with backend development using Node.js (NestJS is a plus)
• Experience building user interfaces with React or similar frameworks
• Understanding of relational databases such as PostgreSQL and core data modeling principles
• Familiarity with RESTful APIs and distributed system communication patterns
• Exposure to cloud platforms like AWS (or similar)
• Awareness of modern architectures (microservices, serverless, or event-driven systems)
• Strong problem-solving ability, ownership mindset, and attention to detail
• Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

Preferred:
• CI/CD, infrastructure as code, or DevOps workflows
• Experience building internal developer platforms, operational tooling, or workflow automation systems
• Exposure to AI-adjacent, data-heavy, or ML-powered products
• Experience working in startup, lab, or high-growth engineering environments
• Familiarity with monitoring, observability, and platform reliability best practices
